text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the morning, on my way to the Trainer's Room,
I spotted Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Since it's relative frequency... I calculate the total
frequency... and then... um... *sigh*

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh... it's just you.
I'm studying, obviously... The exams are coming up soon...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... An honor student is expected to get a perfect score... right?
There's no time... to sleep... at all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she hasn't been getting much sleep.
We'll need to keep a close eye on her physical condition.
